method: Independent comparison against all applicable source text: chapters 1–9 (excluding 9.7), C.1, applicable Glossary, M.1–M.2, V.1–V.3. PDF text checked; PDF item glyphs in 5.1.5 and V.1–V.3 visually inspected. Did not read questions/answer keys, reader outputs/grades, previous audits/reviews or other QA files. Summary was not edited.

source_gaps.gap: The Law refers to physical faction-board track values but does not reproduce exact Marquise building wood/VP/draw tracks, Eyrie roost VP/draw track, Alliance sympathy supporter-cost/VP/draw track, or Vagabond relationship Aid thresholds/advancement VP. The summary accurately directs readers to printed board spaces; exact values cannot be reconstructed from these supplied sources.

The PDF does not reproduce complete shared-deck card faces or the 15 quest card faces. Exact individual card crafting costs/effects and quest item pairs must come from physical cards; the summary describes their procedures without inventing values.
Play duration is not stated in the supplied Law PDF/text, so this catalog metadata is not verified by this source audit. It is not a gameplay-rule finding.

conclusion: No material rule contradiction or important in-scope procedural omission found. Source gaps are recorded rather than filled from outside knowledge.
